title: Levels film hero
description: A full-window hero over a film: dark gradient laid over the media, then left-aligned white text — a wide-tracked capital eyebrow, a huge medium-weight title (56px with open lines on phones, ~96px tight on desktop), a soft white lead and one white button. Vertically centred on desktop, top-weighted on phones.
notes: sized by the window (min-h-svh); leaves 72px at the top for the fixed header
media fills the section like object-fit: cover; empty, a dark placeholder stands in
a .dark scope: white text and button in both modes
name: levels-hero

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: small tracked capitals above the title

props.name: media
props.description: the background film or photo; fill the box (e.g. a video with object-cover). Empty: a dark placeholder
